observations: body L3: the Syriac word is printed with the Western vowel signs: the sign of u (ʿṣāṣā) over the mīm and wāw, and a zqāpā over the zain and over the gāmal, the sort of the zqāpā of «ܡܕܰܒܪܳܢܳܐ» on p. 331.
body L6: «مَكْثٌ» has a fatḥa over the mīm.
body L8, L9: the quotation of at-Tahānawī runs from L8 to L9; «واما» is printed without a shadda and with a kashīda, not transcribed. The parenthesis opened before «واما» closes after the run in L9.
body L10, L12: the headword «المَلَكِيُّ» has a fatḥa on the lām and a kasra under the kāf; Sachau's «المَلِكِيّ» has a kasra under the lām. «[و]الملكيَّ» has a fatḥa over the shadda.
body L14: the three points between «مَيْل» and «عن» are printed inside the Arabic run.
body L16: «كُلُّهُ» has the damma over the shadda laid flat.

body L7, L17, L28, L36: the last digit of «١١٦», the second of «٥٦» and «٦» have the stem at the right and the hook at the top left (a 6); the middle digit of «١٢١» has the stem at the left and the hook at the top right (a 2).
body L21: «لسَمْته» has a fatḥa on the sīn and a sukun on the mīm and no other vowel sign.

body L22: «٣٦{14, 21}» has a 3 joined to a 6 (7.3 points); its top runs flat to the right end, as in «٣٦» on p. 349 (L24), whereas the 1 of «٣١» rises above the 3 (p. 348, L11). «٣٧{20}» is a 3 joined to a 7 (8.8 points). «الٱسْتِوَاء» has the waṣla over the alif, as on pp. 330 and 339; «خَطّ» has the shadda alone both times.
body L23, L25: «٢١–٢٥» is printed with an en dash (4.9 and 5.8 points).
body L27-L29, L31-L33: «النُّجُومِ» (L27) has a kasra under the final mīm; «النجوم» in L28-L33 is unvowelled.
body L31: «أحْكام» has the hamza over the alif without a vowel sign; «صناعَة» has a fatḥa on the ʿayn only.
body L35, L36, L37: the sign in parentheses after «in» (L35) and «quantitatis» (L36) is the Arabic ه, of the shape of the final ه of «مقداره» (L37). «وٱنْسِبْهُ» has the waṣla over the alif.

body L6, L10, L17-L19: «ἥμισυ» has the rough breathing with the acute; ὁ is the δ-shaped sort with the head turned to the right; «ἔγκλι-» and «ἔγκλισις» have the smooth breathing with the acute, «ἐγκεκλιμένου» and «ἐπικύκλου» the smooth breathing.

notes_left L1: «الميْل» has the sukun on the yāʾ and no vowel sign on the mīm; the second «الميل» is unvowelled. «الكُلّيّ» has the shadda alone on the lām and the yāʾ; «الجُزْئِيّ» has the kasra under the hamza and the shadda alone on the yāʾ.
notes_left L1, notes_right L1: note (1) continues from the left column into the right one.
